servicesSurface.scope: /services only; these measurements do not define shared tokens.
servicesSurface.hero: Asymmetric two-line headline on the left and filled quote action on the right; stacked below 1024px. The introduction sits beside the collection heading below the gallery, replacing its trailing rule.

gallery.desktop: One row of four equal portrait panels at widths from 1024px.
gallery.interaction: Complete panels link to localized service detail pages; bottom-overlaid titles and details labels, upper logical end outlined arrow circles and dark lower gradients.
gallery.motion: Image scale(1.035) on hover/focus, with transform 0.8s var(--ease-out-soft); reduced motion removes the image transition and transform.

servicesSurface.details: Descriptive service rows below the gallery retain detail links, service-prefilled quote actions and native inclusion disclosures.

narrative.overview:
This documents the existing application identity preserved by the services redesign. The user requires the same theme, colors and typography, with a modern and elite presentation. No replacement visual identity or named creative metaphor has been established.

Warm charcoal surfaces, ivory text and restrained copper-gold accents support large serif headings, readable sans-serif copy and compact monospaced controls. Photography carries the chauffeur and destination context. The shared quote section reverses the light and dark roles to make the enquiry workflow distinct.
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark surfaces with fine, low-contrast rules.
Fraunces headings, Manrope copy and Space Mono controls, with existing multilingual fallbacks.
Pill-shaped actions, rectangular photography and a softly rounded enquiry card.
Shared navigation and quote behavior across localized pages.

rules.name: The Existing Palette Rule
rules.body: Preserve the source OKLCH values and semantic aliases; compose localized styles from these variables.

rules.name: The Existing Type Rule
rules.body: Retain the established font stacks and language fallbacks when adding or adapting surfaces.

dos: Do preserve the existing semantic colors, exact font stacks and multilingual fallbacks.
Do reuse shared buttons, navigation, footer and quote components.
Do keep feature-specific measurements scoped to their feature styles.
Do retain keyboard focus, reduced-motion behavior and logical right-to-left layout.
donts: Don't introduce replacement colors or typefaces for the services redesign.
Don't promote the services collection's grid or spacing into global tokens.
Don't change service identifiers, locale links or quote preselection while adapting presentation.
